neighbours.label: the word just before 'used'/'use' where a usage verb is expected (may be | often | ease of | when not)
fire: A torque wrench can be used to tighten the bolts.
Lasers are commonly used in eye surgery.
The software is praised for its ease of use.
Bleach should never be used on wool.
These tools are typically used by carpenters.
A stethoscope is usually used to listen to the heart.
When not in use, the blender should be unplugged.
Salt is widely used to preserve meat.
quiet: A torque wrench can be bought at any hardware store.
Lasers are commonly found in modern printers.
The software is praised for its bright colours.
Bleach should never be mixed with ammonia.
These tools are typically sold in sets of three.
A stethoscope is usually hung around the neck.
When the blender is full, put the lid on firmly.
Salt is widely sold in large paper bags.

notes: logit effect: the + pole suppresses 'use/used/usage'. Probes read 0.61-0.90 on the slot word.
